Nelko P21 Label Maker Machine with Tape, Bluetooth Label Printer, White

$16.98
The Nelko P21 is a compact Bluetooth label printer that connects to your phone through a surprisingly decent app with fonts, icons, borders, and barcode support. It prints on thermal tape so there's no ink to replace, and the labels come out sharp and smudge-proof. Great for pantry organization, cable management, kids' school supplies, craft bins, and that one drawer in the kitchen everyone's afraid to open. At $17, it's one of those tools that makes you wonder why you waited so long.
